'''2007 Texas State Championship Olaf Schroeder LS Tatooine''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Olaf Schroeder]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Bionic Luke
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
